description: NLWeb-style question answering over the GlobalHostia site: a natural-language question returns ranked results (plans, domain prices, policies, REVAULT and site features such as bulk domain search, the domain watchlist, Spark and the AI connectors), each with a schema.org object. Use when no more specific tool fits.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

query.description: The question, e.g. "cheapest VPS in Singapore" or "do you refund domains?"

title: Ask the store
